g.text: Taller pole, lower substrate; weaker challenger, then decay
Both native inputs transfer stimulus × inactive into active; finite responses include coupled reaction and transport.
Native peaks: WP 0.1; Goryachev 6.4. These are not matched optical doses or biological clocks.
Widths use each initial half-contrast threshold; zero threshold-defined extent does not mean absent activity. Finite patterns are not tracked site identities or a movement law.
